title: OFF TO ACADEMY CITY!
overview: Allen’s new life in Academy City begins, but an appraisal ceremony unexpectedly puts him on Helmios the Hero’s radar.

title: A NEW FRIEND
overview: The No-Life Gamers are off to a good start, but they face a few setbacks: their healer can't join full-time and Krena doesn't know how to use skills.

title: CONQUER THE DUNGEON
overview: Keel officially joins the No-Life Gamers as they tackle a B-rank dungeon. But as they grow stronger, Allen uncovers a concerning issue regarding his new friend.

title: AN ORDER FROM THE PRINCE
overview: A-rank dungeons are dangerous for a reason, as the No-Life Gamers quickly learn. But that's not the only challenge awaiting them.

title: THE SOVEREIGN OF SPIRITS' PROPHECY
overview: A new school year brings big changes as three new members join the No-Life Gamers.

title: SHOWDOWN AT THE ACADEMY TOURNAMENT!
overview: Allen faces off against the hero. If he wants to win, he’ll have to use his new summoning abilities.

title: ONWARD TO ROHZENHEIM
overview: As the Demon Lord's army lays waste to the Elven Kingdom of Rozenheim, Allen and his friends must find a way to repel the invasion before it's too late.

title: THE BATTLE OF TIAMO
overview: Allen has an unusual request for the Sovereign of Spirits: he wants all of his friends switched over to Hell Mode.

title: THE DEMONS OF LAPOLKA
overview: The No-Life Gamers must hold the line at Tiamo. But the longer the fighting drags on, the fewer magic stones remain at Allen's disposal.

title: PLENTIFUL PRAYERS
overview: The odds are grim. If the No-Life Gamers want to liberate Lapolka, they'll need more than just strategy.

title: THE LIBERATED
overview: One against a million. If Allen wants to even the odds, he'll have to put his new Deputize skill to the test.

title: EXTRA SKILL
overview: Allen's party is determined to retake the Elven capital, regardless of what Helmios says.

title: SUMMONER OF THE BEGINNING
overview: Allen and his friends make their final stand against Rehzel.
